A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MorphSeek work. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures, and supplements are readable and can be matched despite appendix renumbering and layout changes.

before.justification: v2 reports original registration experiments on three benchmarks, component ablations, training analyses, and supplementary quantitative and qualitative results.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, with corrections to selected numerical entries.

M1.justification: The Gaussian latent policy, deterministic warm-up, multi-trajectory GRPO, LDVN, losses, and refinement procedure are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate OASIS brain MRI, LiTS liver CT, and Abdomen MR–CT registration. No dataset, task, population, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments: Table 1 retains the same backbone and external baselines, Table 7 retains RIIR and both LapIRN variants, and Table 8 retains SyN and deedsBCV.

E3.justification: Data splits, preprocessing, labeled-pair budgets, metrics, model configurations, and training procedures are unchanged. The correction note describes rechecking inference outputs, not a revised experimental protocol.

E4.justification: The trajectory/step, label-efficiency, component, LDVN, hyperparameter, posterior-collapse, reward-hacking, and SPAC composition analyses are retained. No analytical question or supporting experiment is added or removed.

E5.justification: The ± reporting, Wilcoxon tests, significance markers, 20-run stability analysis, and Monte Carlo and latent-sampling counts are unchanged. Numerical precision corrections do not introduce a different uncertainty-estimation procedure.

E6.justification: Table 1 contains corrections beyond equivalent rounding: CorrMLP's OASIS NJD changes from 0.08±0.03 to 0.0±0.0, and RIIR's OASIS Dice changes from 87.76±2.55 to 87.7±2.5, also updated in Table 7. Other edits, including Table 9's Original/SPAC entry, only reduce displayed precision. No new experimental results are added.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, LDVN proposition and proof, weak-dependence assumptions, and variance-scaling derivation are retained. The former supplementary Section 7 becomes Section 8 without substantive mathematical revision.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about scalable latent-space optimization, label efficiency, registration accuracy, regularity, and computational overhead.

C2.justification: New Section 7 qualifies the reliability of earlier numerical reporting by acknowledging transcription/formatting errors and unsupported baseline digits. It states that rechecking preserves the conclusions; existing mechanism explanations and failure-condition discussions remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility information is retained in Section 10 of v2 and Section 11 of v3, including architectures, hyperparameters, pair construction, hardware, and software. The correction note provides no new reproduction procedure or resource access.

R1.justification: The cited works, related-work discussion, and positioning relative to previous registration and reinforcement-learning methods are unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 adds a short Correction Note and renumbers subsequent supplementary sections and cross-references. The existing narrative and scientific exposition are otherwise retained.

P2.justification: Table 1 becomes narrower, and the inserted note reflows supplementary text and table placements. Figures 7–8 move to later pages, with Figure 7 separated from its introductory text. Existing figure content, captions, and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: The correction note improves transparency, but the revised table obscures small NJD differences and introduces a conflict with the retained reduction claim. In Table 1, LiTS NICE-Trans versus its MorphSeek variant changes from 0.17 versus 0.16 to 0.1 versus 0.2. The PDFs do not reconcile this displayed reversal with the note's assertion of unchanged rankings, so a reliable net quality improvement cannot be established.
